content:
maria: spotted a customer hit a -12 provisional token row after a cross-region handoff. raising since support escalated.
kevin: logs?
maria: pasted: 
2026-04-02T12:00:01Z router: session=s-500 route=us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 reason=capacity_failover
2026-04-02T12:00:02Z runtime: session=s-500 tokens_emitted=30 status=streaming
2026-04-02T12:00:03Z runtime: session=s-500 toolcall=ocr truncated=true tokens_tool=6
2026-04-02T12:00:05Z billing: session=s-500 provisional_delta=-12
sam: likely route_tag changed on handoff and ledger keyed by route_tag -> two shards touched.
irene: do we have provenance on billing events? runtime has trace id but ledger ignores it.
kevin: short fix: router add X-Orig-Route on handoff; ledger use idempotency key session|prefix|orig_route to merge provisional writes.
ben: UX: console should label provisional negatives as "pending adjustment" and link reconcile trace. I'll open incident.
ops-bot: incident INC-2026-198 created, assigned eng-platform.
kevin: plan: router PR (tests + sim) 1d; ledger idempotency merge 2d; reconcile emit confirmed with final_route tag 1d; console label + temporary filter 0.5d.
sam: I'll add unit test for the toolcall-truncated-before-handshake edgecase.
maria: filing support template and PR for UI copy.
ben: closing when canary 100% and negative provisional rate < 1/min.
